name: zeffect_anim_save_running_anim_records
description: zEffect_Anim::SaveRunningAnimRecords iterates running animation entries from index 1, saves eligible primary entries, and only walks runtime siblings after a primary save is allowed.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x460f80 starts at entry index 1, stops when the prior save result is zero, and skips the table entirely when g_zEffectAnim_EntryCount <= 1.
For each primary entry, it saves only activationState 2 or 6 entries whose flags do not have 0x1000 set unless 0x2000 is also set, and only when g_zEffectAnim_RecordQueueEnabled is non-zero.
Runtime siblings are traversed only after a primary entry passes those gates, and only sibling activationState 2 records are saved with includePrimaryEntry=0.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
